preconditions.description: The size of the matrix N is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(num) <= 100 for row in matrix for num in row)
preconditions.description: Each number in the matrix is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The total number of decreasing paths modulo 10^9+7 is between 0 and 10^9+6 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(decreasing_paths(matrix, x, y) for x in range(N) for y in range(N)) % (10**9 + 7)
postconditions.description: The return value is the sum of all decreasing paths starting from each cell in the matrix, modulo 10^9+7.
